title: Finite-dimensional stable subspace containing a finite set
statement: Let k be a field and H a commutative Hopf k-algebra with comultiplication Δ. For every finite set F⊆H, there is a finite-dimensional k-subspace V⊆H containing 1 and F such that, for every x∈V, Δ(x) lies in span_k{a⊗b | a∈V, b∈H}. All tensor products are over k.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (F : Finset H), ∃ V : Submodule k H, FiniteDimensional k V ∧ (1 : H) ∈ V ∧ (∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ V) ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ V, ∃ b : H, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b})
